known.title: Gate: repair tests broken by the workflow migration

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - run the repository's test suite.
The preceding extractor selects the first tests-job run step, now `uv tool install .`, and passes it to `json.loads`, which raises before this assertion or any group execution. Several unchanged consumers also retain incompatible expectations: tests/test_ci_hang.py:20,33,48 require five inline pytest commands and an inline uv command; tests/test_fix_clone_gets_test_tools.py:82 requires the old inline command; tests/test_testplace_upgrade.py:124 requires the legacy job verbatim; tests/test_fix_close_runs_fast_test_instead_of_test.py:72,89 require the removed doctor exception and `six-group job` wording. Update the extractor and these contracts while retaining their timeout, upgrade and guidance checks; otherwise the suite cannot pass.
findings.title: Gate: repair tests broken by the workflow migration

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - an always_test entry persistently fails in its assigned group.
Done-when 5 explicitly covers passing and failing always-run tests, but this proof only runs a passing entry and requires both groups to succeed. The persistent-failure case in test_3 removes always_test through `_settings(client, test=PYTEST, groups=2)`, so it does not cover this clause. Extend the command-level proof with a failing always_test entry and verify that exactly its owning group remains red after retry while the other group passes.
findings.title: Gate: test_5_always_tests_pass_in_their_owning_group
